us.title: Detonation of unstable explosives in Iowa paused indefinitely by court
us.desc: The U.S. Army's plan to detonate five tons of unstable explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa has been put on indefinite hold by a federal court Friday.

us.title: Officials Find Cascade of Problems With ICE Training in Trump’s Immigration Crackdown
us.desc: In a draft report, officials found widespread training gaps as the Department of Homeland Security sought to rapidly hire and deploy 10,000 new officers.
